registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Command/control register. Software writes command_valid, control_mode, and integrity bits here; readback is defined by the MMIO block implementation.

fields.name: command_valid
fields.description: Software command-valid qualifier. When written as 1 together with a valid command packet, the command is eligible for acceptance.

fields.name: control_mode
fields.description: Requested control mode. Must be permitted by cfg_control_mode_permit for acceptance.

fields.name: integrity
fields.description: Optional integrity bits accompanying the command packet.

registers.name: CMD_ID_SEQ
registers.description: Command identity and freshness register. Captures command_id, sequence_number, and age_or_timestamp.

fields.name: command_id
fields.description: Command identifier.

fields.name: sequence_number
fields.description: Sequence number used for freshness policy and duplicate/older command rejection.

fields.name: age_or_timestamp
fields.description: Compact age or timestamp field used for freshness supervision when enabled by firmware policy.

fields.name: requested_actuator_position
fields.description: Requested actuator position to be validated and clamped by the safety supervisor.

registers.name: CFG_TIMEOUT
registers.description: Timeout, sequence policy, and permitted control-mode configuration.

fields.name: timeout_limit
fields.description: Freshness watchdog timeout limit in cycles or prescaled ticks.

fields.name: seq_policy
fields.description: Sequence-number policy selector.

fields.name: control_mode_permit
fields.description: Permitted control-mode mask.

fields.name: act_min
fields.description: Actuator clamp minimum.

fields.name: act_max
fields.description: Actuator clamp maximum.

fields.name: safe_min
fields.description: Lower safe-limit bound used for inhibited-state legality checks.

fields.name: safe_max
fields.description: Upper safe-limit bound used for inhibited-state legality checks.

registers.name: IRQ_CTRL
registers.description: Interrupt enable and sticky fault clear control.

fields.name: irq_enable
fields.description: Interrupt enable mask for command and fault events.

fields.name: clear_sticky_faults
fields.description: Write-1-to-clear sticky fault bits.

fields.name: accepted_event
fields.description: Accepted-command event indicator.

fields.name: rejected_event
fields.description: Rejected-command event indicator.

fields.name: stale_data_fault
fields.description: Sticky stale-data fault indicator.

fields.name: timeout_fault
fields.description: Sticky timeout fault indicator.

fields.name: clamp_applied
fields.description: Indicates the commanded actuator value was clamped.

fields.name: fallback_active
fields.description: Indicates output validity is inhibited due to fault/reset/timeout/stale conditions.

fields.name: sequence_number_seen
fields.description: Most recent accepted sequence number for telemetry.

fields.name: last_fault_code
fields.description: Encoded last fault code for software handling.

fields.name: watchdog_count
fields.description: Freshness watchdog count or tick telemetry.

fields.name: status_capture_valid
fields.description: Status-capture valid strobe.

sources.name: accepted_event
sources.description: Command acceptance event interrupt when enabled.

sources.name: rejected_event
sources.description: Command rejection event interrupt when enabled.

sources.name: stale_data_fault
sources.description: Sticky stale-data fault interrupt when enabled.

sources.name: timeout_fault
sources.description: Sticky timeout fault interrupt when enabled.

init_sequence: Assert reset and wait for mmio_ready to indicate idle-ready.
Program CFG_LIMITS with actuator clamp bounds and safe limits.
Program CFG_TIMEOUT with watchdog timeout, sequence policy, and permitted control-mode mask.
Program IRQ_CTRL with interrupt enables; leave clear_sticky_faults deasserted unless clearing faults.
Write CTRL, CMD_ID_SEQ, and CMD_POS with a command packet, then set command_valid in CTRL to submit the command.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS to observe accepted_event, rejected_event, stale_data_fault, timeout_fault, clamp_applied, fallback_active, sequence_number_seen, and last_fault_code.
Read WATCHDOG to monitor watchdog_count and status_capture_valid.
If stale_data_fault or timeout_fault is observed, service software recovery and explicitly clear sticky faults using IRQ_CTRL.clear_sticky_faults if permitted.
irq_sequence: On interrupt, read STATUS and WATCHDOG to determine whether the event was command acceptance, rejection, stale-data fault, or timeout fault.
Acknowledge and service the event in firmware.
If required by policy, write IRQ_CTRL.clear_sticky_faults with a 1 to clear sticky faults after software handling.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
All declared registers are reachable through explicit RTL decode on the 32-bit MMIO window.
The streaming model transport is auxiliary and does not replace the MMIO control plane.
No register map is generated for inaccessible internal state or for any physics/model surrogate functionality.
